downside.story: P10: AI optics digestion plus China shock in FY27-28: wireline capture -30% (CY27 800G/1.6T build slows, inventory at transceiver makers), wireless -12% and EI -13% (China revenue -50% = ~-8.7% of FY27 revenue, spread across CC and EI; FY24-style industrial/auto downturn), ADG -4% (continuing resolution), segment margins -4.5pt (mix back toward FY25 26%), P/E -4 turns to ~16.9x ex-SBC (~18.5x costed), normalised leg -30%. Tail includes a China-Taiwan event (6%).

upside.story: P90: supply loosens and the 1.6T/3.2T R&D and manufacturing test cycle runs hotter: wireline capture +35%, wireless +6%, ADG +3%, EI +10% (AI semis/PCB), margins +2-2.5pt on 60%+ incrementals, P/E +5 turns to ~25.9x ex-SBC (~28.4x costed, between AME and Anritsu), normalised leg +40%.

downside.story: 10th percentile: China shock (China revenue -50%, ~-8.7% of revenue; 17.5% China share, 10-K FY25) plus an optics digestion year in CY2028 (LightCounting: 2-3 year upcycles followed by flat/down years; bumpy-ride correction 2027-30 plausible): wireline capture -30%, EI -12% (FY24-style industrial/semis slip), wireless -10%, segment margins -4pt (de-leverage; FY25 was 25.9%), P/E -5x to ~15.8x ex-SBC (~17.3x costed) as the market prices a cycle peak.

upside.story: 90th percentile: LightCounting bull case (cloud capex +70% in 2027 vs +50% base), 1.6T parity with 800G in 2027 (VIAV) and early 3.2T/CPO R&D test, component supply loosens so the 1.13 book-to-bill converts; wireline capture +25%, EI +6%, CSG margin +2pt, P/E +4x to 24.8x ex-SBC (~27.2x costed, between AME and Anritsu).

downside.story: 10th percentile: a China shock (China revenue -50% = ~8.7% of FY27 revenue: entity listings or retaliation cut wireless, EI and semis test in China; ADG barely exposed) lands on top of an AI-optics digestion in which double-ordered transceiver capacity is absorbed (LightCounting: a correction is more likely than a soft landing; transceiver sales turn ~6 months before capex), so wireline capture of the optics market falls 30% below base as test buying of 1.6T lines pauses; margins fall back toward FY24-25 (CSG -4.5pt, EISG -4pt) as the tariff refund and synergy tailwinds are gone and volume leverage reverses; the market pays ~15.5x ex-SBC EPS (~17x SBC-costed, below every whole-company peer) for falling EPS; normalised EPS 15% lower. The ~6% China-Taiwan tail (Polymarket, per supervisor) sits inside this 10th percentile rather than adding to it; the October 2026 optics tape (AI-funding fears, KEYS -15.6% in the month with no downgrades) shows how quickly the multiple de-rates.

upside.story: 90th percentile: supply eases by mid-2027 and the $2B+/quarter order book converts; 1.6T and 3.2T/448G R&D test plus manufacturing test and early 6G spend scale with a market still growing ~30%+ in 2028, wireline capture 25% above base; operating leverage adds 1.5-2pt of margin; the market pays ~25x ex-SBC (~27x SBC-costed, near Anritsu) because the FY29 path still grows.

downside.story: 10th percentile: AI-optics test digestion arrives in CY2027 (LightCounting's 'bumpy ride' case) on top of component shortages; wireline capture -35% vs the approved path, a China shock (China revenue -50%, ~-8.7% of FY27 revenue) inside the wireless -12% / electronic-industrial -15% cuts, segment margins -5pt back toward FY25 levels, P/E -5 turns to ~15.9x ex-SBC (~17.5x SBC-costed, below VIAV/RAL at ~21x), mid-cycle leg -30%.

upside.story: 90th percentile: 1.6T ramps and 3.2T R&D start pull wireline capture +30% vs the approved path, supply loosens so the backlog converts, wireless +4%, EI +6% on AI semis, margins +1.5/+1pt, P/E +5 turns to ~25.9x ex-SBC (~28.4x SBC-costed, at Anritsu 28.5x, top of the whole-company range).

downside.story: 10th percentile: AI-optics test digestion as hyperscaler 800G/1.6T capacity lands (wireline capture -35%), plus the required China shock (China 17.5% of FY25 revenue x -50% = ~-8.7% of revenue, spread over wireless -12%, EISG -15%), an FY24-type industrial soft patch (Kalshi 2027 recession ~20%), segment margins -4/-5pt toward FY24-25, and the P/E derating 4.5 turns to ~16.7x ex-SBC (~18.3x SBC-costed; the Oct-2023 trough was ~15x trailing non-GAAP). Like Dec-2021 to Oct-2023 (-42.6%).

upside.story: 90th percentile: LightCounting's +76% 2027 optics market plus a 3.2T/co-packaged-optics R&D wave lift wireline capture 25%, supply eases so the 1.13 book-to-bill converts, EISG +8%, margins +2pt, and the P/E holds a 4-turn premium (25.2x ex-SBC, ~27.6x costed) as the market treats AI test as structural.

downside.story: P10 (downside case): the mandated China shock (China revenue -50% = 17.5% x 50% = ~8.7% of revenue, 10-K FY25; carried as wireline -10%, wireless -10%, EI -12% inside the deltas) lands on an AI-optics test digestion (LightCounting: correction more likely than a soft landing) so wireline capture falls 30% in total, wireless -12%, EI -15% (FY24-type industrial/auto soft patch), ADG -3%; segment margins -4pt back toward FY24-25; P/E -5 turns (~15.3x ex-SBC, ~16.9x costed; Oct-2023 trough ~15x); mid-cycle leg -30%.
